billing.title: Plan & billing

pay.adminDescription: We hope Bibi has been a good help! Pick a plan to carry on – everything you have set up is right where you left it.

pay.reminded: Your admins have been told. Thanks for the nudge!
pay.alreadyReminded: Your admins have already been reminded. They'll be with you soon.

settings.cancelAtPeriodEnd: The subscription ends when this period is over.

settings.confirmAutoAssignDescription: When every seat is taken, each new invitation adds a paid seat at {price} a month.

requests.empty: No one is waiting for a seat.

finance.noData: Nothing to show for this period.

occupancy.empty: The item is not occupied from now on.

quote.title: Quote, version {version}
quote.formDescription: Set the validity and the terms. The lines are the order's own: add and price them on the order.
quote.sent: The quote has been marked as sent.
quote.declined: The quote has been marked as declined.
quote.revised: A new version has been created.

confirm.send: Mark version {version} as sent to the customer? The order's lines are frozen into it, it can no longer be edited and older sent versions expire.
confirm.accept: Record that the customer accepted version {version}? The order moves on if the pipeline has a status for it.
confirm.decline: Record that the customer declined version {version}?
confirm.expire: Expire version {version}? The customer can no longer accept it.

lines.title: Order lines
lines.none: No priced lines on the order yet.

quote.draftLines: A draft shows the order's priced lines as they are now; sending freezes them.
quote.editLinesOnOrder: Edit the lines on the order

drift.title: The order differs from accepted version {version}
drift.description: The order's lines have changed since the customer accepted. The accepted quote is unchanged; these are the differences.

payment.requestDescription: The customer gets a pay link and pays with the methods you have connected, such as card or Swish. The money goes straight to you.

public.title: Payment to {organization}
public.processingDescription: Thank you. We are waiting for the payment to be confirmed. This page updates by itself.
public.paidDescription: Thank you. The payment to {organization} is complete.
public.expiredDescription: Contact {organization} to get a new link.
public.unavailableTitle: This payment can no longer be made
public.unavailableDescription: Contact {organization} if you think this is wrong.
public.invoiceDescription: An invoice has been sent to you. Use the link in it to pay.
public.secured: Payment is handled securely by the payment service.
public.swishScan: Scan the QR code with the Swish app.
public.swishWaiting: Waiting for the payment to be approved in Swish. This page updates by itself.
public.startFailed: The payment could not be started. Try again in a moment.

payment.amountHint: Leave empty to request the open balance of {open}.
payment.noReceivables: Nothing to pay for yet: send a quote, request a deposit or create an invoice.

methodRequired.title: Connect a payment method first
methodRequired.description: Pay links need a connected service that takes payments, such as Stripe or Swish. An administrator connects one under Administration → Integrations; until then these actions are not available.

refund.title: Refund payment
refund.description: The money goes back to the customer the way it was paid. A payment you recorded yourselves counts as refunded at once; pay the money back outside Bibi.
refund.amountHint: Leave empty to refund all that is left: {left}.

cancel.title: Cancel the payment?
cancel.confirm: The pay link stops working and the payment is no longer requested. If money still comes in, it is recorded.

recordManual.title: Record payment
recordManual.description: For money you received outside Bibi, such as a bank transfer or cash.

ledger.missing: Connect Fortnox or Visma eEkonomi to take payments. They make every invoice and deposit invoice, so deposits, invoices and payment links can be created once one is connected.
ledger.askAdmin: No accounting system is connected, so deposits, invoices and payment links cannot be created yet. Ask an admin to connect Fortnox or Visma eEkonomi.

deposit.createDescription: A fixed amount the customer pays in advance. Send it before you request a payment against it.
deposit.created: The deposit request has been created.
deposit.sent: The deposit request is marked as sent.
deposit.voidConfirm: Void the deposit request "{description}"? It is no longer owed.
deposit.voided: The deposit request has been voided.

request.title: Request deposit
request.description: Creates a deposit and a payment link to send to the customer.
request.linkReady: Send the link to the customer. The customer pays without an account.

hint.PERCENT: Suggested by your deposit rule. Order total incl. VAT: {total}.
hint.FULL: The order total incl. VAT ({total}) is below the minimum, so it is paid in full up front.
hint.NONE: No deposit rule is set. Enter an amount. Order total incl. VAT: {total}.

invoice.createConfirm: Freeze the order's priced lines as an invoice? Later line changes do not change it.
invoice.sent: The invoice is marked as sent.

invoice.voidConfirm: Void invoice #{number}? It is no longer owed and the order can be invoiced again.
invoice.voidPending: Voiding in {name} not confirmed yet, Bibi is retrying

credit.description: A credit note lowers what the customer owes. Money already paid is refunded from the payment.
credit.amountHint: Leave empty to credit all that is still due: {due}.
credit.done: The credit note has been created.

paymentSettings.description: Which service takes each payment method, and the deposit rule.

deposit.title: Deposits
deposit.description: The deposit suggested when you request one for an order.

fields.depositPercent: Deposit (% of the order total incl. VAT)

hints.depositMinimum: Orders below this amount are paid in full up front.

paymentSettings.confirmDepositDescription: Deposit: {percent}. Minimum: {minimum}. From now on, this is what customers are asked to pay in advance.

routes.title: Payment methods
routes.description: Choose which connected service takes each payment method. Automatic uses the connected service that can take it.

STRIPE.name: Stripe
STRIPE.description: Card payments and invoices with a pay link, straight to your organization's own Stripe account.

FORTNOX.name: Fortnox
FORTNOX.description: Accounting and invoicing. Invoices are raised in Fortnox, and payments booked there are mirrored back to Bibi.

SWISH.name: Swish
SWISH.description: Swish for merchants: the customer pays in the Swish app, with a QR code on a computer or straight on the phone.

VISMA.name: Visma eEkonomi
VISMA.description: Accounting and invoicing. Invoices are raised in Visma eEkonomi, and payments booked there are mirrored back to Bibi.
